turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hi Marcus! Happy Sunday. How is your morning going? Did Olive let you sleep in today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey there! Olive actually slept fine, but I ended up oversleeping anyway. I was running so late this morning that I skipped breakfast entirely, which is a big change from my usual oatmeal.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Oh no, hope your morning wasn't too chaotic after that! Did you manage to get everything sorted out?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yeah, I got it taken care of. I'm back home now and ready to just take things easy. It's a rest day for me, so I won't be doing any workouts today.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: A rest day sounds like exactly what you need. Are you planning to spend any of your downtime in your workshop, or are you taking a complete break from woodworking too?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I think I will head out to the garage for a little bit this afternoon. I have a small piece I've been meaning to sand down, and it's nice to just putter around with no real deadline.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds incredibly relaxing. How is the planning for your Japan trip next spring going? Have you and Grace made any more progress on the itinerary?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We actually spent some time looking at Tokyo neighborhoods last night. It's starting to feel very real, though there's still a ton of research left to do.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: The research is half the fun! What are you two planning for the rest of the evening? Anything special for dinner or entertainment?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We'll keep it pretty quiet. We're probably just going to make some dinner and watch sitcom reruns on TV tonight.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Sitcom reruns are the ultimate cozy Sunday night vibe. Will Olive be joining you guys on the couch?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, definitely. As soon as the TV goes on, she'll curl right up between us. It's basically her favorite part of the weekend.
